pr.title: perf(scope): lexical allocation optimization for separate processes

protocol.rules: Serial fresh children; immutable compiled runtime; full tuple validation; no timeouts that kill native work. Baseline and candidate use identical worker, fixture and limits. GC only before first and after last read.

notes: All 18 timed pairs retain identical semantic graph digests and expected persisted call targets.
RSS is whole-process high-water, including seed runs in persistent mode; it is not an isolated identity-check allocation measurement.
Corpus, two workers, 4 GiB heap and FTS workload are fixed. Session order alternates baseline-first/candidate-first; edit pair order also alternates.
